'''Cullen Burns DS 2nd place deck in states''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Cullen Burns]] posted on DeckTech. The post's title calls this the 'DS 2nd place deck in states'; the post does not name the state or the date of the event.<ref name="dt-9650">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9650 DS 2nd place deck in states], DeckTech (Cullen "Sigmar" Burns, 19 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9650/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9650/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018133348/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9650/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
